evidence.quote: This year, however, it is finally time for everyone to actively transition away from using LIBOR.
There is no scenario in which a panel-based USD LIBOR will continue past June 2023, and nobody should expect it to.
While we will examine against all of these points, what is most important this year is that firms should end new use of LIBOR.

parsed.rationale: The speech concerns the LIBOR transition and supervisory expectations, not monetary policy or the economic outlook. It carries no signal on rates, inflation, activity or the balance sheet.
